author: More Perfect Union
description:
Anthropic could have the biggest IPO in history, right as the company sounds the alarm over the supposed existential risk of their AI technology.

Despite the alarm, Anthropic is racing ahead with going public, a move that could make their 300 investors very, very rich.

These early investors have put $130 billion into the company already, and they're among richest people on Earth. So they won't settle for anything less than massive returns, a huge IPO, and endless growth from Anthropic.

Producer: Meagan Day
Editor: @niklaak
Animator: Gina Barton
Research: Lucy Dean Stockton
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: The REAL Reason Anthropic Won’t Actually Slow Down AI
